name: Directional Influence (DI)
goal: Change your launch angle with the control stick
why: DI sets the direction a hit launches you. Against a strong sideways hit, holding the control stick up and toward the stage raises the launch angle by up to 18 degrees, so {char} reaches the side blast zone later and survives to a higher percent. With no DI the same hit kills earlier.

tutorial.what: DI is the control stick's direction on the last frame of hitlag. The game turns the launch angle toward it by up to 18 degrees.
tutorial.expect: Each hit is judged on the first frame of the launch: whether the control stick was held on the last frame of hitlag, and the angle {char} moved at. Gravity makes that angle a few degrees lower than the hit's own 44.

marks.12: Frame 12: the forward smash hits. Hitlag begins
marks.13: Frame 13: the control stick is held up and toward the opponent
marks.19: Frame 19: the last frame of hitlag. The game reads the stick

lessons.title: Hitlag
text: When a hit connects, both fighters freeze: hitlag. Its length comes from the hit's damage: a third of the damage plus 3 frames, rounded down. The opponent's forward smash deals 15, so hitlag lasts 8 frames.
{char} cannot move during hitlag, but the game still reads the control stick. Knockback starts on the frame after hitlag.

lessons.title: How DI works
text: The game reads the control stick on the last frame of hitlag and turns the launch angle toward it by 18 degrees times the square of the stick's component perpendicular to the launch. Perpendicular gives all 18; along the launch line, none.
The forward smash launches {char} at 44 degrees. Up and toward the opponent is perpendicular to that and turns it to about 62. Straight up, 46 degrees off the line, turns it about 9.

marks.12: Frame 12: the forward smash hits. Hitlag begins
marks.13: Frame {f}: hitlag. The stick is held up and toward the opponent
marks.19: Frame 19: the last frame of hitlag. The game reads the stick
marks.20: Frame 20: launched about 18 degrees higher than with no DI

cues.words: Hitlag: hold the stick up and toward the opponent
Last frame of hitlag: the stick is read now

attempt.missed: Not counted: the forward smash missed. Stand still in front of the opponent.

stick held.expect: Control stick held on the last frame of hitlag
stick held.words: the control stick was in neutral on the last frame of hitlag
stick held.headline: No DI
stick held.fix: Tilt the control stick during hitlag and keep it there until {char} is launched. The game reads it only on the last frame of hitlag; a stick let go before then is no DI.

raised.headline: Launch lowered
raised.fix: Hold the control stick up and toward the opponent. A stick held down or away from the opponent turns the launch lower, toward the side blast zone.

full DI.headline: Not perpendicular
full DI.fix: Hold the control stick up and toward the opponent, perpendicular to the launch. Straight up is 46 degrees off the launch line and gives about 9 of the 18 degrees.

parts.name: Hitlag
parts.teach: Stand still and take the opponent's forward smash. {char} freezes for 8 frames of hitlag, then flies away at 44 degrees.

marks.12: Frame 12: the forward smash hits. Hitlag: 8 frames
marks.19: Frame 19: the last frame of hitlag

parts.success: Hit: {hitlag_frames} of hitlag, then launched at {launch} degrees.

parts.name: Hold the stick until hitlag ends
parts.teach: Once {char} freezes, tilt the control stick and keep it there until {char} flies. The game reads the stick only on the last frame of hitlag, and the launch angle changes.

marks.12: Frame 12: the forward smash hits. Hitlag begins
marks.13: Frame 13: the control stick is tilted and held
marks.19: Frame 19: the last frame of hitlag. The stick is read
marks.20: Frame 20: launched at a new angle

cues.words: Hitlag: tilt the stick and hold it
Last frame of hitlag: the stick is read now

parts.name: Perpendicular to the launch
parts.teach: Hold the control stick up and toward the opponent, perpendicular to the launch. The launch turns the full 18 degrees, from 44 to about 62.

marks.12: Frame 12: the forward smash hits. Hitlag begins
marks.13: Frame 13: the control stick is held up and toward the opponent
marks.19: Frame 19: the last frame of hitlag. The stick is read

cues.words: Hitlag: hold the stick up and toward the opponent
Last frame of hitlag: the stick is read now

mistakes.name: let go before the last frame of hitlag

coach.note: Frame 1 is the hit. Hitlag lasts 8 frames; the stick is read on frame 8, the last of them.
